###################################################################
	###################################################################
	def stateChange(stateInfo, userId):
	
		'''
		This function can be overridden to customize it based on a clients needs.
		
		The example implementation here was specific for a client. 
		Change state logic so that a new downtime code entered when state is already down will over-write current state rather than adding a new state change.
		Client has their operator code downtime events before they allow the line to start up. 
		If the current state is 'unplanned downtime', then update the current state record when it changes to a different state that is not 'Running' (or 'Idle'?)	
	
		Example stateInfo dictionary
		stateInfo = {'assetId': assetId, 'assetStateId': assetId, 'stateCode': stateCode, 'partReqd': tagValues[2].value, 'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp, 'assetPath': tagValues[3].value}	
		
		Updated:
			jfc: 1/27/24 Missing origStatecode param in updateStateEvent() call
			jfc: 8/18/25 Modified to check if a downtime event has been updated by a user before overriding the previous event if downtime events are contiguous
			jfc: 11/26/25 Fixed issue where updating a downtime event would also update its timestamp to current time
		'''
	
		dbName = system.kanoa.config.getDBName('MES')
		mesTagProvider = system.kanoa.config.getTagProvider('MES')
		log = system.util.getLogger('kanoaTags')
	
		debug = system.tag.read(mesTagProvider + 'kanoa/debug/tags/debugFlag').value
		if debug: log.info('stateChange() called with %s'%stateInfo)
		
		stateEventId = None	
		if stateInfo['assetId'] is None or stateInfo['assetStateId'] is None or stateInfo['stateCode'] is None:
		 	log.error("Invalid parameters passed to kanoaScripts.custom.ops.stateChange() - %s"%stateInfo)
			return None
		
		stateInfo['stateType'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('stateTypeName', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetStates({'assetId': stateInfo['assetStateId'], 'stateCode': stateInfo['stateCode']}))
		if stateInfo['stateType'] is None: log.warn("No state information configured for this stateCode - %s"%stateInfo)
		elif debug: log.info("state information configured for this stateCode - %s"%stateInfo)
			
		prevStateEventInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.event.getPreviousStateEvent(stateInfo['assetId'], stateInfo['tStamp']),0)
		if prevStateEventInfo['stateEventId']: #We have an entry prior to this timestamp
			if stateInfo['stateCode'] == prevStateEventInfo['stateCode'] and stateInfo['assetStateId'] == prevStateEventInfo['assetStateId']: return None#"State and assetId is the same as the last entry. Do nothing
			elif stateInfo['stateType'] == 'Running': 
				if debug: log.info('New state type is running.  Calling addState()')
				stateEventId = system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(stateInfo, userId)
			elif prevStateEventInfo['stateTypeName'] == 'Running' and stateInfo['stateType'] != prevStateEventInfo['stateTypeName']: 
				if debug: log.info('Last state type is running.  Calling addState()')
				stateEventId = system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(stateInfo, userId)
			else: #If we are here, then old and new state must be downtime. #In this case we will update the last downtime event to what has just been passed in. This is the operator coding the downtime event before starting the line back up
				if prevStateEventInfo['changedBy'] is not None: #User has already coded this downtime event, we will ignore the new downtime event and keep accruing time
					if debug: log.info('Previous and current events are downtime and user has already coded this downtime event. Doing nothing.')
					return None
				if debug: log.info('Previous state and current state are both downtime.')
				if system.date.minutesBetween(prevStateEventInfo['tStamp'], stateInfo['tStamp']) > 300: 
					if debug: log.info("It's been more than 300 minutes since the last state event. Adding a new state event")
					stateEventId = system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(stateInfo, userId) #More than five hours, should we just add a new downtime state?
				else:
					if debug: log.info("Updating current state event")
					stateInfo['stateEventId'] = prevStateEventInfo['stateEventId']
					stateInfo['origAssetId'] = prevStateEventInfo['assetStateId']
					stateInfo['origStateCode'] = prevStateEventInfo['stateCode']
					stateInfo['tStamp'] = prevStateEventInfo['tStamp']
					system.kanoa.event.updateStateEvent(stateInfo, None)
					stateEventId = prevStateEventInfo['stateEventId']
		else: stateEventId = system.kanoa.event.addStateEvent(stateInfo, userId) #if debug: log.info('No data found for last state')
	
		if stateInfo['partReqd'] and stateInfo['stateType'] != 'Running': system.kanoa.event.updateStateEventInfo(stateEventId, 'partReqd', stateInfo['partReqd'], userId)
		
		return stateEventId
	
	###################################################################
	###################################################################

	if currentValue.value != previousValue.value and currentValue.value is not None:
		#State interface is entirely customizable. You can pass whatever values you want to the system.kanoa.asset.custom.stateChange() function
		#which can be overridden in the runable project to add any cunstomization required
		tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../EquipID", "[.]Machine ID", "[.]Part Required", "[.]../eqPath"])
		assetId = tagValues[0].value
		machineId = tagValues[1].value
		assetStateId = machineId or assetId	#The stateCode can come from a cell of the asset that has its own states defined. This tells us the lookup for the stateCode
#		userId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('userId', system.kanoa.security.getUsers({'userName': 'tagChange'}))
		userId = system.tag.read("[.]../Configuration/userId").value
		
		if currentValue.quality.isGood(): stateCode = currentValue.value 
		else: stateCode = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('stateCode', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetStates({'assetId': assetId, 'stateName': 'Off Line'}))
		
		stateChange({'assetId': assetId, 'assetStateId': assetStateId, 'stateCode': stateCode, 'partReqd': tagValues[2].value, 'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp, 'note':None, 'assetPath': tagValues[3].value}, userId)

		#We'll update the OEE state values for display purposes
		stateInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssetStates({'assetId': assetStateId, 'stateCode':stateCode}),0)
		system.tag.write("[.]../OEE/stateName", stateInfo['stateName'] or str(currentValue.value))
		system.tag.write("[.]../OEE/stateTypeName", stateInfo['stateTypeName'] or '')
		system.tag.write("[.]../OEE/stateTypeColor", stateInfo['stateTypeColor'] or '')
		system.tag.write("[.]../OEE/stateColor", stateInfo['stateColor'] or stateInfo['stateTypeColor'] or '')
		system.tag.write("[.]../OEE/stateIconPath", stateInfo['iconPath'] or '')

	return

if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.value is not None and currentValue.value != previousValue.value:
		assetId = system.tag.read("[.]../EquipID").value
		userId = system.tag.read("[.]../Configuration/userId").value
		tStamp = currentValue.timestamp
		itemName = currentValue.value or None
		if itemName == 'null': itemName = None
		workOrderName = system.tag.read("[.]Work Order").value or None
		if workOrderName == 'null': itemName = None
		modeSourceId = system.kanoa.asset.getModeSourceId('PLC')
		modeName = 'Production' if itemName is not None else 'Idle'
		modeCode = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeCode', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId':assetId, 'modeName': modeName}))
		workOrderId, itemId = system.kanoa.event.checkItemInfo(assetId, workOrderName, itemName, userId) #See if this workorder or product exists and if not create it

		assetOperationInfo = {'assetId': assetId, 'modeCode': modeCode, 'workOrderId': workOrderId, 'itemId': itemId, 'standardRate': None, 'modeSourceId': modeSourceId, 'tStamp': tStamp, 'includeChildren': True}
		modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.assetOperationChange(assetOperationInfo, userId)	

		return

#	log = system.util.getLogger('TAGS')	
	assetId = system.tag.read("[.]../EquipID").value	
#	log.warn("assetOEE mode tag for equipId %s changed with initialChange %s currentValue = %s previousValue = %s"%(assetId, initialChange, currentValue, previousValue))

	if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.value is not None and currentValue.value != previousValue.value:
		userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId({'userName': 'tagChange'})
		modeSourceId = system.kanoa.asset.getModeSourceId('PLC')
		tStamp = currentValue.timestamp
		workOrderName = system.tag.read("[.]Work Order").value or None
		workOrderId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue("workOrderId", system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderName': workOrderName})) if workOrderName else None
		modeCode = currentValue.value
		itemName = system.tag.read("[.]Product Code").value or None
		if itemName == 'null': itemName = None		
		itemId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue("itemId", system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemName': itemName})) if itemName else None
	
		assetOperationInfo = {'assetId': assetId, 'modeCode': modeCode, 'workOrderId': workOrderId, 'itemId': itemId, 'standardRate': None, 'modeSourceId': modeSourceId, 'tStamp': tStamp, 'includeChildren': True}
		modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.assetOperationChange(assetOperationInfo, userId)		
		
	return

#	log = system.util.getLogger('TAGS')	
	assetId = system.tag.read("[.]../EquipID").value	
#	log.warn("assetOEE mode tag for equipId %s changed with initialChange %s currentValue = %s previousValue = %s"%(assetId, initialChange, currentValue, previousValue))

	if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.value is not None and currentValue.value != previousValue.value:
		userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId({'userName': 'tagChange'})
		modeSourceId = system.kanoa.asset.getModeSourceId('PLC')
		tStamp = currentValue.timestamp
		workOrderName = currentValue.value
		workOrderId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue("workOrderId", system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderName': workOrderName})) if workOrderName else None
		modeCode =  system.tag.read("[.]Mode").value
		itemName = system.tag.read("[.]Product Code").value or None
		if itemName == 'null': itemName = None		
		itemId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue("itemId", system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemName': itemName})) if itemName else None
	
		assetOperationInfo = {'assetId': assetId, 'modeCode': modeCode, 'workOrderId': workOrderId, 'itemId': itemId, 'standardRate': None, 'modeSourceId': modeSourceId, 'tStamp': tStamp, 'includeChildren': True}
		modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.assetOperationChange(assetOperationInfo, userId)		
		
	return

if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.quality.isGood() and currentValue.value != previousValue.value and currentValue.value > 0 and currentValue.value is not None:
		newValue = currentValue.value
		prevValue = previousValue.value or 0.0	

		if currentValue.timestamp > previousValue.timestamp: deltaValue = newValue - prevValue if newValue > prevValue else newValue
		elif currentValue.timestamp < previousValue.timestamp: deltaValue = prevValue - newValue if prevValue > newValue else prevValue
		else: return
		
		if deltaValue != 0:
			tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../Configuration/wasteCounterId", "[.]../Configuration/userId"])
			counterInfo = {'counterId': tagValues[0].value, 'deltaValue': deltaValue, 'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp, 'itemStateId': None, 'itemId': None, 'workOrderId': None}
			userId = tagValues[1].value
			system.kanoa.event.addCounterEvent(counterInfo, userId)
		
	return

if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.quality.isGood() and currentValue.value != previousValue.value and currentValue.value > 0 and currentValue.value is not None:
		newValue = currentValue.value
		prevValue = previousValue.value or 0.0	

		if currentValue.timestamp > previousValue.timestamp: deltaValue = newValue - prevValue if newValue > prevValue else newValue
		elif currentValue.timestamp < previousValue.timestamp: deltaValue = prevValue - newValue if prevValue > newValue else prevValue
		else: return
		
		if deltaValue != 0:
			tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../Configuration/outfeedCounterId", "[.]../Configuration/userId"])
			counterInfo = {'counterId': tagValues[0].value, 'deltaValue': deltaValue, 'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp, 'itemStateId': None, 'itemId': None, 'workOrderId': None}
			userId = tagValues[1].value
			system.kanoa.event.addCounterEvent(counterInfo, userId)
		
	return

if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.quality.isGood() and currentValue.value != previousValue.value and currentValue.value > 0 and currentValue.value is not None:
		newValue = currentValue.value
		prevValue = previousValue.value or 0.0	

		if currentValue.timestamp > previousValue.timestamp: deltaValue = newValue - prevValue if newValue > prevValue else newValue
		elif currentValue.timestamp < previousValue.timestamp: deltaValue = prevValue - newValue if prevValue > newValue else prevValue
		else: return
		
		if deltaValue != 0:
			tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../Configuration/infeedCounterId", "[.]../Configuration/userId"])
			counterInfo = {'counterId': tagValues[0].value, 'deltaValue': deltaValue, 'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp, 'itemStateId': None, 'itemId': None, 'workOrderId': None}
			userId = tagValues[1].value
			system.kanoa.event.addCounterEvent(counterInfo, userId)
		
		return

if currentValue.value:
	
		try:
			assetId = system.tag.read("[.]../EquipId").value
			workOrderId = system.tag.read("[.]workOrderId").value
			
			valueNames = ['modeId', 'modeName', 'modeTypeName', 'modeColor', 'startDate', 'modeSourceName',  'userName', 'workOrderId', 'workOrderName', 'reqdQty', 'woActualQty', 'itemId', 'itemName', 'itemDescription', 'infeedUnits', 'outfeedUnits', 'wasteUnits', 'unplannedDowntimeSecs', 'plannedDowntimeSecs', 'runtimeSecs', 'packageCount', 'targetCount', 'infeedCount', 'outfeedCount', 'wasteCount', 'standardRate', 'period', 'availability', 'performance', 'quality', 'durationSecs', 'infeedRateSecs', 'iconPath']
			tagPaths = ["[.]" + col for col in valueNames]	
			tagValues = [None for col in valueNames]
			
			data = system.kanoa.event.getAssetProductionEvents({'assetId': assetId or -1, 'activeModeOnly':True})
			data = system.dataset.filterColumns(data, valueNames)
			eventInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(data, 0)
			tagValues = [eventInfo[col] for col in valueNames]
						
			#work order stuff
			tagPaths.append("[.]woRemainingMinutes")
			tagPaths.append("[.]outfeedRatePerMinute")
			if workOrderId is None or eventInfo['modeTypeName'] != 'Production':
				tagValues.append(None)
				tagValues.append(None)
			else:
				stdRate = eventInfo['standardRate']
				if eventInfo['durationSecs'] is None or eventInfo['outfeedCount'] is None: 
					actualOutfeedRatePerMin = None
					remainingMins = None
				else:
					actualOutfeedRatePerMin = eventInfo['outfeedCount'] / (eventInfo['durationSecs']/ 60.0)
					remainingMins = (eventInfo['reqdQty'] - eventInfo['woActualQty']) / actualOutfeedRatePerMin if eventInfo['reqdQty'] is not None and actualOutfeedRatePerMin > 0 else None

				tagValues.append(remainingMins)
				tagValues.append(actualOutfeedRatePerMin)
	
			system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, tagValues)
		except:
			pass
		
		import time
		time.sleep(0.5)
		
	system.tag.write(tagPath, False)
	
	return

if not system.tag.read("[.]../Enable Quality").value: return

	if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.quality.isGood() and currentValue.value != previousValue.value and currentValue.value is not None:
		tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../EquipId", "[.]shiftNameId", "[.]itemId", "[.]modeId", "[.]toolingId"])
		stateInfo = {
						'assetId': tagValues[0].value,
						'shiftNameId': tagValues[1].value,
						'itemId': tagValues[2].value,
						'modeId': tagValues[3].value,
						'toolingId': tagValues[4].value,
						'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp,
						'changeType': 'Product Change'
					}
	
		if stateInfo['assetId'] is None: return
		system.kanoa.quality.schedule.assetChangeEvent(stateInfo)

	return

if not system.tag.read("[.]../Enable Quality").value: return

	if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.quality.isGood() and currentValue.value != previousValue.value and currentValue.value is not None:
		tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../EquipId", "[.]shiftNameId", "[.]itemId", "[.]modeId", "[.]toolingId"])
		stateInfo = {
						'assetId': tagValues[0].value,
						'shiftNameId': tagValues[1].value,
						'itemId': tagValues[2].value,
						'modeId': tagValues[3].value,
						'toolingId': tagValues[4].value,
						'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp,
						'changeType': 'Mode Change'
					}
	
		if stateInfo['assetId'] is None: return
		system.kanoa.quality.schedule.assetChangeEvent(stateInfo)

	return

if not system.tag.read("[.]../Enable Quality").value: return

	if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.quality.isGood() and currentValue.value != previousValue.value and currentValue.value is not None:
		tagValues = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]../EquipId", "[.]shiftNameId", "[.]itemId", "[.]modeId", "[.]toolingId"])
		stateInfo = {
						'assetId': tagValues[0].value,
						'shiftNameId': tagValues[1].value,
						'itemId': tagValues[2].value,
						'modeId': tagValues[3].value,
						'toolingId': tagValues[4].value,
						'tStamp': currentValue.timestamp,
						'changeType': 'Shift Change'
					}
	
		if stateInfo['assetId'] is None: return
		system.kanoa.quality.schedule.assetChangeEvent(stateInfo)

	return

if initialChange or currentValue.value:
		assetPath = system.tag.read("[.]../eqPath").value
		info = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetOEEThresholds({'assetPath': assetPath})
		tagPaths = ["[.]a", "[.]p", "[.]q", "[.]oee", "[.]oeeTolerance", "[.]aTolerance", "[.]pTolerance", "[.]qTolerance"]
		tagValues = [info['a'], info['p'], info['q'], info['oee'], info['oeeTolerance'], info['aTolerance'], info['pTolerance'], info['qTolerance']]
		 
		system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPaths, tagValues)
		import time
		time.sleep(0.5)
		system.tag.write(tagPath, False)
		
		return

if currentValue.value:
		assetPath = system.tag.read("[.]eqPath").value
		currentAssetId = system.tag.read("[.]equipID").value #in case db connection is FAULTED, we'll re-use the persistent tag value
		assetId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': assetPath}))
		system.tag.write("[.]EquipID", assetId or currentAssetId)
		import time
		time.sleep(0.5)
		
	system.tag.write("[.]refresh", 0)
	
	return

system.tag.write("[.]updateScheduleData", 1)
	system.tag.write("[.]updateWOData", 1)
	
	return

if currentValue.value:

		log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_tag')
		import java.lang
		
		try:	#Wrap this in case there is an error with finding the 'shared' folder. Does happen after a restart...
			startDate = system.date.addDays(system.date.now(), -3)
			endDate = system.date.addDays(system.date.now(), 3)
			dictList = system.kanoa.schedule.getCalendarEvents({'scheduleType': 'operation', 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate})
			data = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDictListToDataset(dictList)
			
			system.tag.write("[.]ScheduleData", data)	
		except java.lang.Exception, e:
			log.error("updateScheduleData tag script failed with %s"%(e.cause))
		except:
			log.error("updateScheduleData tag script failed ")
			
		import time
		time.sleep(0.5)
		system.tag.write("[.]updateScheduleData", 0)

if currentValue.value:

		import java.lang
		log = system.util.getLogger('kanoa_tag')		
		
		try:
			pass	#execute some function here
		except java.lang.Exception, e:
			log.warn("%s timer script failed with %s"%(tagPath, e.cause))
		except:
			log.warn("%s timer script failed"%(tagPath))
		
		import time
		time.sleep(0.5)	#in case tag is being triggered manually, the change will be visible to the person
		
		system.tag.write("[.]lastUpdated", system.date.now())
		system.tag.write("[.]update", 0)
	
	return
system.tag.write("[.]../counterValue", 0)

if not initialChange and currentValue.quality.isGood() and previousValue.quality.isGood() and currentValue.value > 0 and system.tag.getTagValue("[.]enabled"):
		# UPDATE COUNTER
		pmCount = system.tag.getTagValue("[.]counterValue")
		if pmCount is None: pmCount = 0
							
		if tag['parameters']['countOnIncrease'] == 1:
			if currentValue.value > previousValue.value:
				delta = currentValue.value - previousValue.value
			else: return
		else:
			if currentValue.value < previousValue.value:
				delta = previousValue.value - currentValue.value
			else: return
		
		pmCount = pmCount + delta
			
		system.tag.write("[.]counterValue", pmCount)
		
		# UPDATE LOT EVENTS FOR THE CURRENT LOT OPERATION
		lotOperationEventId = system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotEventInfo/lotOperationEventId")
		if lotOperationEventId is None: return
		
		userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId({'userName': 'SYSTEM'})
		now = system.date.now()
		
		# OUTPUT THE DELTA TO THE OUTPUT ASSET ID
		# use the lotInfo and lotEventInfo data provided in the outputLotInfo and outputLotEventInfo parameters
		outputAssetId = system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotEventInfo/assetId")
		lotStateId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotStateId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotStates({'lotStateName': system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotEventInfo/lotStateName")}))
		
		if tag['parameters']['alwaysMakeNewOutputLot'] != 1:
			outputLotEventId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotEventId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotEvents({'lotOperationEventId': lotOperationEventId, 'assetId': outputAssetId, 'lotStateId': lotStateId}))
		else:
			outputLotEventId = None
		
		if outputLotEventId is None:
			outputLotInfo = {
				'lotName': system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotInfo/lotName"),
				'itemId': system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemId', system.kanoa.item.getItems({'itemName': system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotInfo/itemName")})),
				'itemUnitId': system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemUnitId', system.kanoa.item.getItemUnits({'itemUnitName': system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotInfo/itemUnitName")}))
			}
			
			lotNumber = 1
			while lotNumber > 0:
				#todo: for now, just send what you want the "root" lot number to be and we'll find the right 3-digit code for it
				lotName = outputLotInfo['lotName'] + "-"+ str(lotNumber).zfill(3)
				if system.kanoa.lot.getLots({'lotName': lotName}).getRowCount()>0:
					lotNumber = lotNumber + 1
				else: lotNumber =-1
			outputLotInfo['lotName'] = lotName
			outputLotId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLot(outputLotInfo, userId)
			
			outputLotEventInfo = {
				'lotId': outputLotId,
				'assetId': outputAssetId,
				'comment': system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotEventInfo/comment"),
				'lotStateId': lotStateId,
				'lotStateReasonId': system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotStateReasonId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotStateReasons({'lotStateReasonName': system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotEventInfo/lotStateReasonName")})),
				'shiftId': system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('shiftId', system.kanoa.shift.getShifts({'shiftName': system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotEventInfo/shiftName")})),
				'workOrderId': system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('workOrderId', system.kanoa.order.getProductionOrders({'workOrderName': system.tag.getTagValue("[.]outputLotEventInfo/workOrderName")})),
				'lotEventId': None,
				'lotEventQty': 0,
				'itemSourceId': system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('itemSourceId', system.kanoa.item.getItemSource({'itemSourceName': 'output'})),
				'lotOperationEventId': lotOperationEventId,
				'tStamp': now
			}
			outputLotEventId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLotEvent(outputLotEventInfo, userId)
